visual_review: Front-view bust (ring head exactly 8 above the shoulder line, rounded shoulders) with the left arm raised into a long baton reaching the top-left corner and the right arm out wide; reads as a conducting figure at 48. The baton continues the raised arm, so the two read as one long gesture.
omissions: Hands, the baton's thinner weight and the coat detail.
